childhood_events.title: A Big Day at School
childhood_events.description: It's your turn to give a presentation at school. All the other kids are watching.

outcomes.label: Speak with confidence
outcomes.description: Stand tall and give an excellent presentation.

effects.message: The teacher praises your bravery!
It's over... You can breathe again.

childhood_events.title: Making New Friends
childhood_events.description: Some kids at the playground wave you over to join their game.

effects.message: You make friends and have a wonderful time!
You enjoy the game from the sidelines.

childhood_events.title: A Family Picnic
childhood_events.description: Your family has organized a picnic at the park. Everyone brings their favorite foods.

effects.message: A perfect day with family, laughing and eating by the river.

childhood_events.title: Oh No, Lost My Toy!
childhood_events.description: You can't find your favorite stuffed animal anywhere.

effects.message: Found it behind the bed! You're so relieved.
Mom finds it in the closet. What a relief!

childhood_events.title: Your Birthday!
childhood_events.description: Today is your special day! There's cake, presents, and all your friends.

effects.message: The best day of the year! Cake, presents, and all your friends cheering!

childhood_events.title: Reading Your First Book!
childhood_events.description: You've learned to read! You can finally read your first book by yourself.

effects.message: The world of stories is now yours!

childhood_events.title: A Secret Garden
childhood_events.description: You find a hidden garden behind the old barn. Butterflies flutter everywhere.

effects.message: Your own secret world, filled with flowers and butterflies.

childhood_events.title: Learning to Ride
childhood_events.description: Your parents sign you up for riding lessons. The horse is bigger than you thought!

effects.message: You learn to sit tall and control the horse!
The horse is gentle and friendly. Maybe next time.

childhood_events.title: You Get a Pet!
childhood_events.description: Your parents bring home a new kitten for you!

effects.message: A fluffy new friend to love and care for!

childhood_events.title: Jumping in Puddles
childhood_events.description: It's raining! The street is full of puddles to jump in.

effects.message: SPLASH! The best feeling in the world!

childhood_events.title: Building a Snowman
childhood_events.description: It's snowing! Your friends want to build the biggest snowman ever.

effects.message: You build an enormous snowman with a carrot nose!

childhood_events.title: Catching Fireflies
childhood_events.description: On a warm summer evening, fireflies light up the garden.

effects.message: Little lights dance around you in the darkness.

childhood_events.title: The Scarecrow Seems to Move
childhood_events.description: You're walking past the fields and you think the scarecrow has turned.

effects.message: It was just the wind. Phew!
Better safe than sorry!

childhood_events.title: Sharing Treats
childhood_events.description: You have a special cookie. There's one other kid who looks hungry.

effects.message: The other kid thanks you and smiles. Sharing is nice.
Cookies are delicious!

childhood_events.title: An Elder Needs Help
childhood_events.description: An old man is struggling to carry his groceries. He looks like he needs some help.

effects.message: The old man thanks you and gives you a coin.
Maybe next time...

childhood_events.title: A Lost Dog
childhood_events.description: You find a puppy wandering alone, looking sad.

effects.message: The happy puppy's family thanks you!
The puppy wags its tail gratefully.

childhood_events.title: Helping at the Shop
childhood_events.description: The shopkeeper lets you help out for a few hours. It's your first real work experience.

effects.message: You earn your first real wages!

childhood_events.title: The Old Dungeon
childhood_events.description: The older kids challenge you to peek into the old dungeon entrance.

effects.message: You explore the dark passages and find treasure!
A little too scary for now.

childhood_events.title: Reading at the Library
childhood_events.description: You spend an afternoon reading books at the town library.

effects.message: The world expands through the power of reading.

childhood_events.title: A Butterflies in Your Stomach
childhood_events.description: You see someone at school and suddenly your heart starts racing.

effects.message: Oh no... Is this what people mean by 'crushes'?

childhood_events.title: The Autumn Harvest
childhood_events.description: The whole town celebrates the harvest festival with games and food.

effects.message: Pumpkin pie, hayrides, and apple cider! The best festival!

childhood_events.title: The Midsummer Bonfire
childhood_events.description: All the teens gather around the bonfire, telling stories and roasting marshmallows.

effects.message: Stories of monsters and adventure by the crackling fire.

childhood_events.title: The First Dance
childhood_events.description: You're invited to the teen dance at the community hall.

effects.message: Twirling and laughter under the fairy lights!

childhood_events.title: Winter Solstice
childhood_events.description: The family gathers to celebrate the shortest day with warm food and stories.

effects.message: Candles, warmth, and the promise of spring to come.

coming_of_age_event.title: Coming of Age!
coming_of_age_event.description: You are now a full adult with access to everything the world offers — jobs, dungeons, PVP, leadership roles, and more!

permanent_effects.notification: You step into adulthood with promise and adventure ahead!
